content.title: From Suffering to Glory, Part 2
content.author: R. C. Sproul · Romans sermon, Ligonier Ministries
content.note: For Romans 8:28 and Genesis 50:20: God's good purpose and human evil intentions can concern the same event. The promise belongs to those who love God; it does not make evil good.
